title: Diagnostic accuracy of convolutional neural network algorithms to distinguish gastrointestinal obstruction on conventional radiographs in a pediatric population
summary: CNNs distinguished gastrointestinal obstruction on pediatric radiographs with measured diagnostic accuracy. The diagnostic result is limited to the study cohort, reference standard, and validation used.
